entry_thesis: Shift4 Payments founder Jared Isaacman bought ~$15.7M of FOUR shares (296K+ shares) across Feb 26-Mar 2 — a massive conviction signal that went viral on StockTwits with 533% message volume surge. Stock is deeply oversold post-earnings (down 25% YTD) with ~25-35% short interest creating potent insider-buy + narrative momentum + short squeeze catalyst setup.
risk: Ongoing analyst downgrades and weak 2026 guidance may continue to pressure the stock if macro sentiment deteriorates further.
catalyst: Founder insider buying of $15.7M triggers viral retail momentum, combined with elevated short interest building short squeeze pressure
